platform_scope: Linux CPU float64; isolated authoring environment
font_family: Noto Sans/Serif CJK installed from system distribution; binaries not bundled

limitations: Direct versions are not a full cross-platform lockfile; system Pango and fonts affect PDF layout; GPU/Jupyter browser UI/fresh Anaconda install on other OS not tested.
